claims.title: Controlled resonant actions have an exact polynomial state candidate through zero strata, without measured speedup

status: source_derived_unreviewed; Exact wave artifacts and informed internal reconstructions preserved; no independent proof audit or scientific replay during intake. External correctness and exact priority UNKNOWN; acquisition-inclusive advantage NOT_DEMONSTRATED. No civilisation-level discovery or physical validation established.
interface: For the supplied real controlled star i xdot_i=k_i conjugate(y_i)c, i ydot_i=k_i conjugate(x_i)c, i cdot=sum_i k_i x_i y_i with k=Kv in R^r and a fixed admitted d-dimensional control span, the source constructs an exact polynomial state for every modal action, including amplitude-zero strata. Set a=|x|^2, e=|y|^2, n=|c|^2, b_i=x_i y_i, s=a+e, p_i=Im(b_i conjugate(c)), S_ij=Re(b_i conjugate(b_j)), R=SK, P=K^T p and L=K^T(k elementwise s). Then adot=edot=-2k elementwise p, ndot=2k^T p, pdot=Rv-k elementwise s n, and Rdot_i,alpha=-k_i s_i P_alpha-L_alpha p_i. Storage and derivative work are O(rd+r), with supplied dense K already costing rd entries. No division by amplitudes is used.
limits: Independently reconstruct realizable zero-stratum closure, behavioral equivalence and additional-control criterion; compare exact formulas with classical resonant invariant/realization literature. Identify a measured acquisition or control task that favors products over amplitudes, and obtain matched complete costs before escalating; retain the slower benchmark and alternative O(r) Lipschitz baseline.
